features: Understand your body. Unlock your potential: Go beyond everyday fitness tracking with REP's Sleep, Recovery and Effort Scores. Discover how well your body has rested, understand your readiness for the day and measure your physical effort with meaningful insights that help you train smarter, recover better and build consistent habits.

Deeper health insights, around the clock: Get a clearer picture of your body's changing patterns with 24x7 monitoring of heart rate, Heart Rate Variability (HRV), resting heart rate, respiratory rate, stress and skin temperature variation. Understand how your body responds to activity, rest and recovery through detailed insights in the NoiseFit App.

Make every effort count: Whether you're training, running or staying active throughout the day, REP helps you understand the effort behind every movement. With 20+ sports modes, heart rate zones, Effort Score and automatic detection of five common activities, track workout intensity, monitor your progress and build endurance over time.

Designed to move with you, day and night: Built for continuous wear, REP features a lightweight 27g design, breathable nylon weave strap and premium stainless steel finish. Its discreet, display-free design stays comfortably on your wrist through workouts, workdays and sleep, helping you stay present while your fitness tracking continues.

More insights. Fewer interruptions: Experience continuous fitness tracking with up to 10 days of battery life and 5ATM water resistance. Access your health metrics, sleep trends and performance insights through the NoiseFit App without recurring subscription fees, giving you the freedom to focus on your progress rather than your device.
